plan.label: portable-export-import
plan.title: Portable Export/Import
plan.summary: Add ipman export-portable and import-portable commands so workspaces can move between machines without losing the encrypted database.

phases.label: foundations
phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Transport key derivation (Argon2id passphrase-based) and passphrase reader with termios + IPMAN_PASSPHRASE escape hatch.

phases.label: db-transfer-layer
phases.title: DB Transfer Layer
phases.summary: ipman_export_portable() and ipman_import_portable() in migrate_ops.c using ATTACH + sqlcipher_export pattern.

phases.label: cli-tests
phases.title: CLI & Tests
phases.summary: Wire export-portable / import-portable subcommands in main.c and add integration test with IPMAN_PASSPHRASE escape hatch.

tasks.label: ipman-key-derive-passphrase-unit-test-implementation
tasks.title: ipman_key_derive_passphrase() — unit test + implementation
tasks.summary: Add to ipman_key.h/c. Argon2id INTERACTIVE over raw passphrase bytes + 16-byte salt. Unit test: determinism, different salt → different key, different passphrase → different key. Add Makefile recipe for test_transport_key.

tasks.label: passphrase-reader-src-passphrase-h-src-passphrase-c
tasks.title: Passphrase reader — src/passphrase.h + src/passphrase.c
tasks.summary: ipman_read_passphrase(): check IPMAN_PASSPHRASE env var first (scripting/test path), then /dev/tty with termios ECHO suppressed. Reject empty passphrase. Caller must sodium_memzero after use.

tasks.label: ipman-export-portable-migrate-ops-c
tasks.title: ipman_export_portable() — migrate_ops.c
tasks.summary: Bundle format: [IPMX magic 4B][version 1B][argon2id salt 16B][SQLCipher DB bytes]. Transport-encrypt a DB copy (ATTACH + sqlcipher_export), prepend header, write to out_path at 0600. Double passphrase prompt when interactive; skip confirm if IPMAN_PASSPHRASE set.

tasks.label: ipman-import-portable-migrate-ops-c
tasks.title: ipman_import_portable() — migrate_ops.c
tasks.summary: Read+validate header, extract DB to temp, derive transport key, verify decryption, ipman_home_ensure + ipman_keysalt_ensure, transfer to machine-keyed target via ATTACH + sqlcipher_export, apply migrations. Refuse if ipman.db already exists at target.

tasks.label: cli-wiring-main-c
tasks.title: CLI wiring — main.c
tasks.summary: Add run_export_portable() and run_import_portable() static functions. Register export-portable and import-portable in parse_command(). Dispatch in main(). Both follow the same argv-parsing pattern as run_export() and run_import_plan().

tasks.label: integration-test-tests-integration-260-export-portable-sh
tasks.title: Integration test — tests/integration/260_export_portable.sh
tasks.summary: Full round-trip: init src workspace, create 1 plan + 1 phase + 2 tasks, export-portable (IPMAN_PASSPHRASE), import-portable into fresh workspace, verify plan title + phase count + task count. Also verify wrong passphrase is rejected and does not leave partial workspace.
